svg.title: Five Fee Rails, One Base Revenue Total
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-fee-rail-revenue-contribution; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Fee Rails, One Base Revenue Total; subtitle: Compare annual earned dollar contributions rather than asset values.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative negotiated fee mix totaling $505,000. Bars measure annual recognized operator dollars, not market benchmarks, investment returns, or capacity commitments. The five fee events may span three successful sites.; caption: A payment rail earns its place only when its rights, milestone evidence, and payment trigger are separately documented.; stages: label: AI campus option assignment; value: $150,000 from one completed campus option assignment; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: One transferable principal-held option earns a $150,000 assignment fee after buyer acceptance. Verify campus zoning, carrier-confirmed dark-fiber routes, cooling and water feasibility, and utility service conditions; exclude the parcel purchase price.; label: Standalone BESS option assignment; value: $125,000 from one completed storage parcel assignment; numeric value: 125000.0; detail: One assignable 5–25 acre storage parcel interest earns $125,000. Document injection and charging limitations, fire access, setbacks, interconnection conditions, and transfer rights independently of any nearby data-center development.; label: Utility-evidenced MW milestone; value: $100,000 from twenty documented MW at $5,000; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Twenty utility-documented deliverable MW multiplied by a negotiated $5,000 milestone rate yields $100,000 only upon the contractual earning event. Attach upgrade exposure, study conditions, and energization assumptions to the capacity statement.; label: Development readiness milestone; value: $80,000 from one separately earned readiness payment; numeric value: 80000.0; detail: One $80,000 contractual milestone requires specified land-use findings, access rights, and accepted technical deliverables. A signed option or preliminary queue entry alone does not satisfy that event.; label: Realized development carry; value: $50,000 from one settled development carry distribution; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Include $50,000 only after the carry crystallizes under the applicable arrangement. Exclude speculative future project appreciation, unearned promote value, and consideration already included in another fee rail.

text.title: Five Fee Rails, One Base Revenue Total
text.tspan: Five Fee Rails, One Base Revenue Total

rect.title: label: AI campus option assignment; value: $150,000 from one completed campus option assignment; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: One transferable principal-held option earns a $150,000 assignment fee after buyer acceptance. Verify campus zoning, carrier-confirmed dark-fiber routes, cooling and water feasibility, and utility service conditions; exclude the parcel purchase price.

label: Standalone BESS option assignment; value: $125,000 from one completed storage parcel assignment; numeric value: 125000.0; detail: One assignable 5–25 acre storage parcel interest earns $125,000. Document injection and charging limitations, fire access, setbacks, interconnection conditions, and transfer rights independently of any nearby data-center development.

label: Utility-evidenced MW milestone; value: $100,000 from twenty documented MW at $5,000; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Twenty utility-documented deliverable MW multiplied by a negotiated $5,000 milestone rate yields $100,000 only upon the contractual earning event. Attach upgrade exposure, study conditions, and energization assumptions to the capacity statement.

label: Development readiness milestone; value: $80,000 from one separately earned readiness payment; numeric value: 80000.0; detail: One $80,000 contractual milestone requires specified land-use findings, access rights, and accepted technical deliverables. A signed option or preliminary queue entry alone does not satisfy that event.

label: Realized development carry; value: $50,000 from one settled development carry distribution; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Include $50,000 only after the carry crystallizes under the applicable arrangement. Exclude speculative future project appreciation, unearned promote value, and consideration already included in another fee rail.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative negotiated fee mix totaling $505,000. Bars measure annual recognized operator dollars, not market benchmarks, investment returns, or capacity commitments. The five fee events may span three successful sites.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Illustrative negotiated fee mix totaling $505,000. Bars measure annual recognized operator dollars, not market
benchmarks, investment returns, or capacity commitments. The five fee events may span three successful sites.
